heading: Other ways to work with Nahim

items.title: Keynote speaking
items.blurb: For conferences, award evenings, staff days and large audiences. 20 to 60 minutes, built around your event.

items.title: Panels and conversations
items.blurb: In-conversation formats, panels and Q&A. Good for events that want something less polished and more honest.

items.title: Workshops
items.blurb: Half-day and full-day sessions for youth workers, frontline teams and leaders. Practical, not theoretical.

items.title: Schools, colleges and universities
items.blurb: Assemblies, guest lectures and student sessions. Nahim has lectured at UEL and spoken in Tower Hamlets schools.

items.title: Advisory
items.blurb: For organisations working with young people, communities or place-based change. Strategy, engagement and what actually works on the ground.
